concepts.name: Geographical Enquiry And Map Making 237
concepts.simple_definition: Geographical Enquiry and Map Making 237 Breaking points are determined through a clustering algorithm that maximizes similarity with class and difference between classes
concepts.deep_explanation: The default option for data classification in many GIS software is natural break because natural break organizes data in itself, and works in most (if not all) cases

concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Geographical Enquiry and Map Making 237  with adjacent topics in Chapter 6.

concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The default option for data classification in many GIS software is natural break because natural break organizes data in itself, and works in most (if not all) cases — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: UNIT ONE UNIT ONE UNIT EIGHT 238 A Quant
concepts.simple_definition: UNIT ONE UNIT ONE UNIT EIGHT 238 A quantile map divides data in terms of percentiles
concepts.deep_explanation: If data is grouped into five classes, the first class (865–11031) represents the 0–20th percentile, the second class represents the 20– 40th percentile, and the fifth class (47615–105350) represents the 80–100th percentile
